description: What to source NEXT, adjacent to what the seller already sells. Seeds Webotee's undercompeted-brand and underserved-niche engines from the seller's OWN connected catalog (their dominant brands and categories), excluding brands they already carry. Requires a connected store (Starter+). Use for 'what should I source next', 'expand my catalog', 'adjacent opportunities', 'what else could I sell'.

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR
